lead: Wednesday opened on the funding wire: data security startup [Cyera raised $400M](../summaries/4eaf196b01fe.md) from Goldman Sachs, [Firecrawl raised a $75M Series B](../summaries/aed66f1ed130.md) for its agent web-scraping tools, and [Micro1 raised $100M+ at a $4B valuation](../summaries/f29ad7754038.md). [Anthropic partnered with OpenEvidence](../summaries/7ae0154c4306.md) on a specialized medical AI, [Rabbit launched OS3](../summaries/4c7cb941cc78.md), a cloud agent that reaches local apps and files on Windows, and [Alibaba outlined its first cloud regions](../summaries/5c70f233b9ff.md) in Turkey, Finland and the Netherlands. The early reading list: DeepSeek's [sandbox infrastructure for agentic training](../summaries/e35d02aab32b.md) and a guide to [talking about AI without anthropomorphizing it](../summaries/6f154f0d0568.md).
